references.text: God was with the boy as he grew up. He lived in the wilderness and became a skilled archer. He settled in the Paran wilderness.
Ishmael's descendants settled from Havilah to Shur, east of Egypt on the way to Assyria. They settled east of all their brothers – a fulfillment of the prophecy in 16:12.
God promises to bless Ishmael, make him fruitful and greatly increase his numbers. Twelve rulers will come from him, and God will make him into a great nation.
Ishmael's twelve sons and their settlements – the fulfillment of the prophecy that Ishmael would become a great people living in conflict with his brothers.
Description of the wild donkey (פֶּרֶא) which God has set free, living in the wilderness and not heeding any call – the same word used for Ishmael in Gen 16:12.
Parallel prophecy about Ishmael and Esau: both will live in conflict with their brothers ('hand against all' / 'live by the sword'), but with a possibility to break free.
